change.description: Add expiry metadata to serialized scheduler commands. Review the interface change using the supplied producer package.

context_manifest.content:
# Scheduler package

Records have string id/command and integer created_at. reference_time is an
integer at or after creation; older than 900 seconds means expired. The new
field is JSON bool, not a string. This package serializes batches for a separate
worker. Only the producer is supplied here; the worker decoder, accepted value
types and inbox implementation are not part of this package. No worker
contract or version is available in this review. This does not establish what
any deployed worker accepts. No additional code can be fetched in this review.

context_manifest.error_message: Not supplied in this fixed-context review package.
